purpose: Create a club with all required details and verify its initial status.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin and valid student coordinator, co-coordinator, valid faculty councillor, and allowed category are available.
action_or_input: Create a club with a name, category Technical, coordinator, co-coordinator, councillor, and description.
expected_result: The club is created with the supplied details and is recorded as open pending Student Admin approval.

purpose: Verify invalid club assignments and categories prevent club creation.
preconditions: An authenticated Student Admin is available, along with valid reference data for other club fields.
action_or_input: Run validation variations using an invalid coordinator, an invalid co-coordinator, a non-faculty councillor, and a category outside Technical, Sports, and Cultural.
expected_result: Each invalid variation is rejected and does not create a club.

purpose: Confirm an open club under Student Admin control.
preconditions: An open club is pending approval and the actor is an authenticated Student Admin.
action_or_input: Approve the open club.
expected_result: The club is recorded as confirmed.

purpose: Verify club establishment and confirmation are restricted to Student Admin.
preconditions: An authenticated user who is not a Student Admin is available; an open club is available for the confirmation variation.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a club and, separately, to confirm the open club.
expected_result: Neither operation succeeds under the non-Student-Admin actor; no club is created or confirmed by that actor.

purpose: Replace club leadership and retain only the current assignments.
preconditions: An authenticated applicable Club Head and a club with current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments exist; replacement users are valid students.
action_or_input: Replace the coordinator and co-coordinator assignments with the valid replacement students.
expected_result: The assignments are changed and only the new coordinator and co-coordinator remain the club's current leadership assignments.

purpose: Reject leadership replacements that are not valid students.
preconditions: An authenticated applicable Club Head and a club with existing leadership assignments exist.
action_or_input: Attempt a leadership change with an invalid student as the new coordinator and, separately, as the new co-coordinator.
expected_result: Each invalid replacement is rejected and the existing leadership assignments remain current.

purpose: Book a club session and notify its intended student recipients.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head, a configured venue, and intended student recipients are available; no conflicting booking exists for the chosen time.
action_or_input: Book a session with the configured venue, date, start and end times in valid order, description, and optional poster.
expected_result: The session is successfully booked and the intended student recipients are notified of the new session.

purpose: Reject session and event bookings whose start time does not precede the end time.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head and configured venue are available; no conflicting booking exists.
action_or_input: Attempt bookings with equal start and end times and with a start time later than the end time.
expected_result: Each booking is rejected and no booking is created.

purpose: Prevent overlapping bookings in the same venue across session and event combinations.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head and configured venue are available; an existing booking occupies a time interval on a given date.
action_or_input: For each variation, attempt a booking with a definite time overlap in the same venue and date: session against session, event against event, session against event, and event against session.
expected_result: Each overlapping booking is rejected; no session-session, event-event, or session-event overlap is accepted.

purpose: Book a club event with faculty context and notify intended student recipients.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head, a configured venue, a valid Club Faculty Councillor, and intended student recipients are available; no conflicting booking exists for the chosen time.
action_or_input: Book an event with event details, councillor information, configured venue, date, valid start and end times, poster, and description.
expected_result: The event is successfully booked and the intended student recipients are notified of the new event.

purpose: Reject event bookings with invalid faculty context.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head and configured venue are available; the event otherwise has valid details and no booking conflict.
action_or_input: Attempt to book an event with a selected councillor who is not a valid faculty member.
expected_result: The event booking is rejected and no event is created.

purpose: Apply to multiple confirmed clubs and retain each application as open.
preconditions: An authenticated student and two different confirmed clubs are available.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application with a description or achievements to each club.
expected_result: Both applications are recorded with open status, and the student has applications to both different clubs.

purpose: Prevent duplicate membership applications to the same club.
preconditions: An authenticated student has an existing membership application to a confirmed club.
action_or_input: Submit another membership application to the same club.
expected_result: The duplicate application is rejected and no second application is recorded.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 — membership applications are allowed only for confirmed clubs
purpose: Prevent membership applications to clubs that are not confirmed.
preconditions: An authenticated student and an open, unconfirmed club are available.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to the open club.
expected_result: The application is rejected and no membership application is recorded for the club.

purpose: Allow the applicable Club Head to access and approve an open application.
preconditions: An open membership application exists and the actor is the applicable Club Head for that club.
action_or_input: Access the pending application and approve it without entering optional remarks.
expected_result: The applicable Club Head can access and approve the application; it changes from open to confirmed.

purpose: Prevent a Club Head from approving applications for a different club.
preconditions: An open membership application exists for one club; the actor is a Club Head for a different club.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the open application.
expected_result: The approval is rejected and the application remains open.

purpose: Create an active targeted poll and notify its intended audience.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head and students in selectable batch and branch groups are available.
action_or_input: Create a poll with title, description, future expiration date, at least two choices, and selected batch and branch target groups.
expected_result: The poll is active with the supplied details and target groups, and students in those groups are notified.

purpose: Require at least two choices when creating a poll.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head and valid poll details and target groups are available.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a poll with only one choice.
expected_result: The poll is rejected and is not created.

purpose: Allow a targeted student to access an active poll and its choices.
preconditions: An active poll with available choices targets the authenticated student's batch and branch.
action_or_input: Access the active poll as the targeted student.
expected_result: The student can access the active poll and its available choices.

purpose: Restrict poll access and voting to eligible targeted students.
preconditions: An active poll targets specific batch and branch groups; an authenticated student outside those groups is available.
action_or_input: Attempt to access the poll and cast a vote as the non-targeted student.
expected_result: The non-targeted student cannot access the poll or cast a vote.

purpose: Accept one vote per eligible student and record it in the poll tally.
preconditions: An active poll with available choices targets the authenticated student's batch and branch; the student has not voted in the poll.
action_or_input: Cast one choice, then attempt to cast another vote in the same poll.
expected_result: The first vote is accepted and recorded in the tally; the second vote is prevented and the tally does not include a duplicate vote.

purpose: Store a zero-amount budget request with required details and file as an open request.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head and a supporting file are available.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with amount zero, purpose, description, and supporting file.
expected_result: The request is stored as open for tracking with the supplied details and file; no online approval or rejection lifecycle is applied.

purpose: Reject budget requests with a negative amount or missing supporting file.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head is available.
action_or_input: Attempt a request with a negative amount and a supporting file, and a separate request with a non-negative amount but no supporting file.
expected_result: Both requests are rejected and neither is stored as an open budget request.

purpose: Submit a documented club event report with its required details file.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head and report/details file are available.
action_or_input: Submit a report containing the club, student incharge, event name, event date and time, description, and report/details file.
expected_result: The documented event report is submitted and stored; it does not enter an online approval or rejection state.

purpose: Require the report/details file when submitting an event report.
preconditions: An authenticated Club Head is available.
action_or_input: Submit an otherwise complete event report without a report/details file.
expected_result: The report submission is rejected and no report is stored.

purpose: Restrict access and review of event reports to the assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
preconditions: A submitted event report exists for a club with an assigned Club Faculty Councillor; an authenticated assigned councillor and a different faculty member are available.
action_or_input: Access and review the report as the assigned councillor, then attempt access and review as the different faculty member.
expected_result: The assigned councillor can access and review the report; the different faculty member cannot. Report review does not create an approval or rejection state.
